verses.1: Hallelujah. I will praise the LORD with all my heart in the assembled congregation of the upright.
verses.2: Great are the works of the LORD, to be treasured for all their delights.
verses.3: Majestic and glorious is your work, your wise design endures forever.
verses.4: You won renown for your wondrous deeds; gracious and merciful is the LORD.
verses.5: You gave food to those who fear you, mindful of your covenant forever.
verses.6: You showed powerful deeds to your people, giving them the lands of the nations.
verses.7: The works of your hands are right and true, reliable all your decrees,
verses.8: Established forever and ever, to be observed with loyalty and care.
verses.9: You sent deliverance to your people, ratified your covenant forever; holy and awesome is your name.
verses.10: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; prudent are all who live by it. Your praise endures forever.

notes.text: In the assembled congregation of the upright: in the temple. Cf Psalm 149:1.
Your: the psalm refers to God in the third person throughout; the shift to the second person is for the sake of inclusive language.
Food to those who fear you: probably a reference to the manna in the desert, which elsewhere is seen as a type of the Eucharist. Cf John 6:31-33, 49-51.
The fear of the LORD: reverence for God, the Hebrew term for religion.
